comparison.objective: Carry and seat a loaded pan level in a close-fitting well; candidate commissions an adjustable axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transport and level insertion versus tool alignment, setscrew release, collar tuning and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: No spill/drop, flange seating, release and stillness versus two safe impact cycles and witness-tested setting retention.
comparison.reason: Close-fit placement and spill avoidance do not test iterative damping adjustment. Candidate leaves excessive-rebound, overload and drift thresholds undeclared.
